category_title: Students experiencing sensory overload and avoidance behaviors due to trauma
scenario_title: Arriving to class unprepared after navigating triggering hallways
minimal_context: Natasha arrives at the classroom and is asked to take out her textbook and assignment for the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take your seat. We are starting the lesson, so take out your textbook and the assignment from yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have my book. The hallways... the smells out there made me dizzy and weak... sick to my stomach almost.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need the book for today's lesson. What about the assignment?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I only have part of it done. Everything is just cloudy upstairs today. It takes all my effort just remembering what room it is in and going.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Oh, Natasha, you chose to join us today. We expect you to be prepared when you do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs her bag and turns to leave the classroom) I can't do this. When you say things like that, you just don't want to go back after that.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please take your seat. We are starting the lesson, so take out your textbook and the assignment from yesterday.

STUDENT: I don't have my book. The hallways... the smells out there made me dizzy and weak... sick to my stomach almost.

TUTOR: Oh, Natasha, you chose to join us today. We expect you to be prepared when you do.

STUDENT: (Grabs her bag and turns to leave the classroom) I can't do this. When you say things like that, you just don't want to go back after that.

task.content: Attempting to attend class and complete assignments while struggling with basic organizational demands, such as remembering what room it is in and bringing the right book

context.environment: Classroom environment, after navigating school hallways where sights and smells trigger intrusive memories

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When a teacher makes a sarcastic remark about her attendance, saying, 'Oh, Natasha, you chose to join us today.'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Leaving class and expressing a desire not to return to school
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Experienced this as humiliating, feeling that 'you just don't want to go back after that'
related_quotes: Oh, Natasha, you chose to join us today.
you just don't want to go back after that.
